question: Is the shared residual direction mostly fixed across sources, or does each conditioning source require its own common direction?
hypotheses: A step/block-specific mean direction from the other five sources retains the observed radial geometry, consistent with a transferable common orientation.
A source-specific common direction is necessary: held-source orientation or radial energy prediction changes substantially. Within-source mismatch controls alone cannot separate this alternative.
template: At each step/block/state, average the 32-row residual means of exactly the other five source clusters. Pre-FFN and actual post-FFN templates kept separate. No held-source output, group label, residual or gate enters template construction.
evaluation: For each held source and five fixed groups, compare ideal epsilon-LN radial energy fractions at actual paired rows, own-source common residual and leave-one-source-out common residual. Report cosine of the two common residual vectors and absolute radial-fraction differences. Same six discovery-exposed sources; no fresh holdout claim.
scope: Same 96 captured nonfinal-block scopes and 480 decoded group directions. Descriptive saved-data transfer only, not a sparse selector, native action or quality/speed acceptance.
